description: This file defines the TransactionFactory class, which models the <transaction-factory> element in the entity configuration. It handles parsing XML elements related to transaction configuration, including class name, user transaction JNDI, and transaction manager JNDI.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: A class that models the <transaction-factory> XML element, providing access to its attributes and child elements related to transaction configuration.

methods.name: TransactionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TransactionFactory object by parsing the provided XML element.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class attribute value for the transaction factory.

methods.name: getUserTransactionJndi
methods.description: Returns the UserTransactionJndi child element, or null if not present.

methods.name: getTransactionManagerJndi
methods.description: Returns the TransactionManagerJndi child element, or null if not present.
